Router not accessible. Need to check LAN Cable of XF4.
Check for the 24v and 0v as per schematics.

additional_info.subject: Sudeep on site 25.03.25 WO1992
site visit
additional_info.body:
The modem is not detecting the client's SIM card. However, when we insert our own SIM card, the modem recognizes it without issue. Additionally, we've noticed that the modem occasionally powers off. Our recommendation is to replace both the modem and the SIM card.
Model and part number: 8EM5903-0AA01-3AA8; 4G LTE & WiFi Cellular Router.
